sources.caption: HUNTER Γ (GAMMA) / LIGHT STUN / pcsx2 2020-03-28 12-55-48-919.png
sources.observations: Exact Outbreak final-game creature captured in PCSX2. Entire crown, torso, both hands including digit tips, both bent legs and both webbed feet lie inside the image; background human is a separate subject, not an occluder of the creature. Dark game lighting; mouth open during light stun. One near forearm overlaps belly but complete hands and feet are visible. Slate-blue rough dorsal skin, small ochre bumps, broad eyeless amphibian head, red-brown throat, rounded pale blue-gray ventral plates with reddish separations, long arms and thin bent hind legs. No apparel or weapon.

sources.caption: HUNTER Γ (GAMMA) / MEDIUM STUN / pcsx2 2020-03-28 12-51-56-921.png
sources.observations: Same final Outbreak model and location. Complete body frame, both feet clearly separated, arms swept forward with overlapping fingers; provides opened mouth profile and belly/leg texture confirmation. Separate human to exclude from generated image. Neutral standing proportion should not derive from a stretched recoil pose alone.

sources.caption: Resident Evil Outbreak/Biohazard Outbreak
sources.observations: Complete native-style low-poly textured model render, front three-quarter. Full head, both hands and feet framed; slate-blue skin, red throat, belly scale layout and long limb proportions agree with independently inspected PCSX2 screenshots. White background includes an archive watermark. Third-party hosting and render pipeline not independently certified; use as shape supplement, not official screenshot proof.
